tools.name: chinwag_org_status
tools.justification: Read-only query over signed blind organization telemetry summaries; mutates nothing and never accesses external open-world resources or repository files.

tools.name: chinwag_run_status
tools.justification: Read-only lookup of a verified 12-beat blind run receipt by opaque reference; idempotent, non-destructive, and closed-world.

tools.name: chinwag_board_status
tools.justification: Read-only query returning aggregated delivery board step and gate counters for the caller's authorized organization.

tools.name: chinwag_credit_ledger
tools.justification: Read-only balance and receipt inspection on the authoritative organization credit ledger; cannot reserve, purchase, or debit credits.

tools.name: chinwag_docs_search
tools.justification: Read-only search against the curated Chinwag documentation corpus; idempotent, non-destructive, and closed to arbitrary web URLs.

tools.name: chinwag_docs_get
tools.justification: Read-only retrieval of a version-pinned Chinwag documentation entry by canonical slug; zero mutation or open-world fetch.

tools.name: chinwag_read_thread
tools.justification: Reads a bounded local repository thread snapshot without mutating state or contacting external services.

tools.name: chinwag_pin_context
tools.justification: Appends an idempotent local context pin keyed by pin ID without deleting data or reaching external networks.

tools.name: chinwag_handoff
tools.justification: Records an idempotent local handoff offer in the admitted repository store without destructive changes or network egress.
